name: Kamauri Whitfield
strengths: Whitfield tracks the ball naturally and creates takeaways with timing at the catch point.
Whitfield is physical for 5-10 / 185, triggering downhill in run support and finishing in space.
Whitfield's press footwork maintains leverage while mirroring through breaks.
Whitfield competes through contested catches and does not play soft off the line.
weaknesses: Whitfield's height will be tested vs longer outside receivers -- recovery when beaten still needs polish.
comparison: Whitfield comps to Taron Johnson -- compact, physical nickel/boundary corner who plays bigger than the listing with ball production (size-matched to Whitfield's 5-10 / 185 mold).
projection: Whitfield projects as develop into the CB room, earn early special-teams and nickel snaps, then compete for a starting slot/dime role -- starter upside as a physical ball-hawk nickel.
schemeFit: Whitfield fits White's nickel/press CB who can also contribute on the perimeter.
insiderNotes: Vault film desk on Kamauri Whitfield via On3->Hudl (The First Academy 2025 junior): 5-10 / 185 CB out of Orlando, FL. Florida 2027 commit.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from On3 Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default.
